'''2010 Yavin 4 Regionals John Veasey LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[John Veasey]] at [[2010 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' wys asteroids v2
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
